title: check-adr-0087-registration: `runtime-export-retired` can never certify an operand named `default` (predicate 2 word-scans `default` across every metadata surface)
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-steve` · session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`, from the #26206 os-dev report (6427264229, out_of_scope_findings[0]). ⛔ Filed bare: grading and `domain:*` are triage's (this gate anchors to `domain:spec` per the lane table; #26220 is the open card on the same gate). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** A package that retires a `default` export has no honest ADR-0087 disposition. `runtime-export-retired` is the true one, and the gate refuses it on every repository, so the only routes are landing red or a disposition that misstates the change. It blocks the second half of #26206: dropping `@objectstack/driver-memory`'s legacy `default` export, which nothing in the repo imports and whose CJS build puts it on `.default` (attw `FalseExportDefault`).

**Reader who acts.** The owner of `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`.

## Measured (branch of PR #26321's card thread, `--base origin/main`, 2026-10-26 ~20:40Z)

- A changeset with marker `runtime-export-retired @objectstack/driver-memory#default` and a FROM → TO block: `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exit 1.
- Gate output: `runtime-export-retired @objectstack/driver-memory#default` [predicate 2: no-metadata-surface] is false: `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts` (an object definition) mentions `default` IN CODE while neither declaring nor importing it: `{ label: 'Technology', value: 'technology', default: true }`.
- `metadataSurfaceReference` (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` ~L3100) word-scans the export NAME across metadata surfaces. `default` is an ordinary object key in field options, defaults and schemas, so the scan hits on every tree.

## Expected

- For an operand whose export name is `default`, predicate 2 reads the import arm only (a metadata surface reaches a default export through an `import x from '<pkg>'`, which that arm already resolves), not the bare-word arm.
- A battery row: a default-export retirement with an unrelated `default:` key in a metadata surface is green; the same tree with a metadata surface that imports the package's default is red.

## Also seen (not filed)

- Predicate 3's FROM reader took the second backticked span of `` - FROM `default` (`import memoryDriver from …`) TO … `` as the operand. That is an authoring shape the changeset can avoid, noted only.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo: "adr-0087 runtime-export-retired default export operand predicate 2 no-metadata-surface false positive" → #22918, #22915 (the category's creation, closed), #12881, #15489 (other predicate defects, closed). None covers a `default` operand. **New.** Related: #26220 (open: same gate, ui package roots), #26206 (blocked half).
